summary: Dana Inc., a motor vehicle parts manufacturer, filed an 8-K to disclose entering Amendment No. 8 to its existing Credit and Guaranty Agreement. The amendment adds a new $500 million senior secured delayed draw term loan A facility, maturing 364 days after borrowing and available in a single draw until August 1, 2026. The proceeds may be used for general corporate purposes, including repurchasing 2031 notes. Interest accrues at the same rate as revolving credit advances, with quarterly amortization of 10% of the principal beginning December 31, 2026. The facility is guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event.
